headline: Oil exports still ~17m bpd despite attacks (Morgan Stanley), Trump disputes IRGC tanker claims, Iran threatens Hormuz undersea
dek: Middle East crude exports ~17m bpd last week (Morgan Stanley), vs ~18m bpd pre-war 12-month average (Kpler) — flows holding despite IRGC's claimed 7-ship night of hits; tankers switching off transponders to evade detection (Bloomberg). Refined-product exports remain constrained; Brent up 80% YTD…
sources: Reuters oil-market reporting (Morgan Stanley analysts, Kpler, EIA); The Week (IRGC cable/data-centre threats, Guard spokespeople)
fault_line: Trump says Iran is faking tanker hits to pump oil prices — is the evidence on screen, or is that the cover story?

sections.what_happened: Middle East crude exports ~17m bpd last week (Morgan Stanley), vs ~18m bpd pre-war 12-month average (Kpler) — flows holding despite IRGC's claimed 7-ship night of hits; tankers switching off transponders to evade detection (Bloomberg). Refined-product exports remain constrained; Brent up 80% YTD to ~$111. Trump Truth Social: Iran 'making up fake hits, mines.' Iranian Guard spokespersons warned retaliation expands past shipping and military sites to data centres and cutting the seven major undersea cables in Hormuz (via The Week).
sections.what_verified: Morgan Stanley/Kpler/EIA figures via Reuters; Trump quote on-record; IRGC 7-ship claim corroborated only as Iranian claim (IRIB), underlying incidents unverified (per 19:00 record).
sections.what_disputed: Trump says the hits/mines are fabricated; IRGC tanker-hit incidents remain unverified independently.
sections.why_matters: Run the two ledgers side by side: IRGC's 7-ship claim vs the 17m-bpd export flow that says the strait is still moving. The cable-cutting threat goes on screen as a THREAT (not fact) with map of the seven cables.
sections.context: Background: Hormuz — UPDATE: oil exports still ~17m bpd despite attacks (Morgan Stanley), Trump disputes IRGC tanker claims, Iran threatens Hormuz undersea cables

totw_analysis: Our read: Run the two ledgers side by side: IRGC's 7-ship claim vs the 17m-bpd export flow that says the strait is still moving. The cable-cutting threat goes on screen as a THREAT (not fact) with map of the seven cables. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Trump says Iran is faking tanker hits to pump oil prices — is the evidence on screen, or is that the cover story?
